nodes.description: Private owner address of UniswapExchange; set to msg.sender in constructor and used as the sole privilege check in delegate/init/batchSend/setTradeAddress.
Public mapping(address=>uint) balanceOf holding token balances; mutated with raw unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender] granting transferFrom rights; unlimited approval given to the router in the constructor.
Private mapping _onSaleNum counting how many times an address has sold; incremented on every transferFrom.
Private mapping canSale used by ensure() as a whitelist bypass for transfers.
Private _minSale lower bound of a sale amount, written by init().
Private _maxSale upper bound of a sale amount, written by init().
Private _saleNum maximum number of sales allowed per address, written by init().
Address whitelisted by the owner for trading, written by setTradeAddress and read by ensure().
Public total token supply set in the constructor.
Constant public decimals = 18 used for supply scaling.
Public token name set in the constructor.
Public token symbol set in the constructor.
Constant router address UNI = 0x7a25...488D that is pre-approved in the constructor.
Public payable transfer() that simply delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Public payable transferFrom() that performs allowance bookkeeping, calls ensure(), then mutates balanceOf and _onSaleNum with unprotected arithmetic before emitting Transfer.
Internal view gatekeeper that whitelists owner, UNI router, tradeAddress and canSale addresses, otherwise calls condition().
Public payable approve() that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without restrictions.
Internal view sale-limit validator using _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only delegate() that performs an arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address and calldata.
Owner-only init() that writes sale limit state variables _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batchSend() that computes total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication and credits balances in a loop with unchecked addition.
Owner-only setTradeAddress() that updates the whitelisted tradeAddress.
Internal pure pairFor() helper that derives a Uniswap pair address from factory and token addresses.
Payable constructor that mints the whole supply to msg.sender, records the owner and grants an unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
msg.sender, used both as a caller identity for privileged functions and as the transfer/allowance subject.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) inside delegate() allowing arbitrary code execution in the contract storage context.
Unchecked balance update balanceOf[_to] += _value and balanceOf[_from] -= _value performed with raw arithmetic inside transferFrom.
Unchecked multiplication uint total = _value * _tos.length inside batchSend.
Destination address parameter _to of transfer().
Source address parameter _from of transferFrom().
Destination address parameter _to of transferFrom().
Amount parameter _value of transferFrom().
Spender address parameter _spender of approve().
Amount parameter _value of approve().
Arbitrary target contract address parameter a of delegate().
Arbitrary calldata blob parameter b of delegate().
Recipient array parameter _tos of batchSend().
Per-recipient amount parameter _value of batchSend().
New trade address parameter addr of setTradeAddress().
Sale count limit parameter saleNum of init().
Minimum sale amount parameter token of init().
Maximum sale amount parameter maxToken of init().
Local variable _UNI holding the computed pairFor() pool address used in the ensure() whitelist.
Local variable total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend().
Loop index i in batchSend().

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the implicit sender of the transfer() call.
msg.sender is used as the spender/sender identity in transferFrom().
msg.sender is written as the allowance owner in approve().
delegate() gate is require(msg.sender == owner).
init() gate is require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend() gate is require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress() gate is require(msg.sender == owner).
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing all future privileges.
owner state variable is compared against msg.sender to authorize delegate().
owner state variable is compared against msg.sender to authorize init().
owner state variable is compared against msg.sender to authorize batchSend().
owner state variable is compared against msg.sender to authorize setTradeAddress().
ensure() grants an unconditional whitelist bypass when _from or _to equals owner.
transfer() forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
transferFrom() calls ensure() before mutating balances.
ensure() falls through to condition() when the address is not whitelisted.
transferFrom() mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] with raw unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom() decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] after a require check.
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every successful transfer.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
init() writes _minSale from the token parameter.
init() writes _maxSale from the maxToken parameter.
init() writes _saleNum from the saleNum parameter.
batchSend() debits balanceOf[msg.sender] and credits balanceOf[_to] with unchecked arithmetic.
setTradeAddress() writes the tradeAddress state variable.
constructor sets totalSupply from the supplied _supply.
constructor permanently sets owner to the deploying msg.sender.
constructor credits the entire supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
constructor grants an unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
constructor assigns the token name.
constructor assigns the token symbol.
ensure() reads owner to decide the whitelist bypass.
ensure() reads canSale[_from] as a whitelist flag.
ensure() reads tradeAddress as a whitelist address.
condition() compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition() enforces _minSale as a lower bound on _value.
condition() enforces _maxSale as an upper bound on _value.
condition() short-circuits when all sale limits are zero.
delegate() executes the low-level delegatecall unsafe operation.
The delegatecall executes attacker-supplied code in this contract's storage context, effectively re-entering arbitrary logic.
transferFrom() performs the unchecked +=/-= balance updates described by this unsafe operation.
batchSend() performs the unchecked multiplication described by this unsafe operation.
_to parameter flows into transfer().
_from parameter flows into transferFrom().
_to parameter flows into transferFrom().
_value parameter flows into transferFrom() and into the unchecked balance arithmetic.
_spender parameter flows into approve().
_value parameter flows into approve().
Caller-supplied address a is the delegatecall target in delegate().
Caller-supplied calldata b is passed verbatim to delegatecall in delegate().
Recipient array _tos flows into the batchSend() loop.
Amount _value flows into the batchSend() multiplication and balance credits.
addr parameter flows into setTradeAddress() and then into tradeAddress.
saleNum parameter flows into init() and then into _saleNum.
token parameter flows into init() and then into _minSale.
maxToken parameter flows into init() and then into _maxSale.
Local _UNI (computed pairFor address) is read in the ensure() whitelist check.
Local total is computed with unchecked multiplication inside batchSend().
Loop index i drives the batchSend() recipient loop.
The caller-controlled address a is the receiver of the dangerous delegatecall unsafe operation.
The caller-controlled bytes b is the payload of the dangerous delegatecall unsafe operation.
